Game Overview

In Impostor Among Space, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a spaceship as the cunning Impostor, eliminating AI crewmates and sabotaging systems in a suspenseful stealth quest. Execute covert ops using vents and fake emergencies, but tread carefully—being detected means game over. Outsmart the vigilant crew and seize control to emerge victorious!

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Impostor Among Space is easy to pick up. Navigate a spaceship as the cunning Impostor, eliminating AI crewmates and sabotaging systems in a suspenseful stealth quest. Execute covert ops using vents and fake emergencies, but tread carefully—being detected means game over. Outsmart the vigilant crew and seize control to emerge victorious!
